# Arthur Labs Documentation

> Arthur Labs Documentation (docs.arthurlabs.net) is the central knowledge hub for Arthur Labs Inc. It contains technical documentation for the DEAN marketplace system, educational blog posts on Web3 and blockchain development, comprehensive guides on DeFi, crypto tax, smart contracts, and marketplace operations, and legal/compliance documentation for Arthur Labs services.

## Documentation Sections

- [Home](https://docs.arthurlabs.net/): Documentation landing page with overview of all Arthur Labs systems -- DEAN, ROSE, QUINN, and SUSAN
- [Marketplace Documentation](https://docs.arthurlabs.net/marketplace): Technical documentation for the DEAN decentralized marketplace factory
- [Marketplace Services](https://docs.arthurlabs.net/marketplace/services): Service offerings and capabilities
- [Smart Contracts](https://docs.arthurlabs.net/marketplace/smart-contracts): Smart contract architecture and standards
- [Legal Structure](https://docs.arthurlabs.net/marketplace/legal-structure): Legal framework for marketplace operations
- [Terms of Service](https://docs.arthurlabs.net/marketplace/terms): Full terms governing marketplace usage
- [Privacy Policy](https://docs.arthurlabs.net/marketplace/privacy): Data handling and privacy practices
- [Data Compliance](https://docs.arthurlabs.net/marketplace/data-compliance): Compliance standards and practices
- [Common Questions](https://docs.arthurlabs.net/marketplace/common-questions): Frequently asked questions
- [Marketplace Questions](https://docs.arthurlabs.net/marketplace/marketplace-questions): Technical marketplace FAQ

## Guides

- [Whitepaper Overview](https://docs.arthurlabs.net/guides/whitepaper-overview): Summary and walkthrough of the Arthur Labs whitepaper
- [Local Web3 Startups](https://docs.arthurlabs.net/guides/local-web3-startups): Guide for starting a Web3 business locally
